description: Deploys 5000 individual VMs with pre-created NICs to eliminate ARM NIC throttling. Two-phase deployment: NICs first, then VMs referencing existing NICs. Each VM has 1 OS disk and 2 Premium V2 SSD data disks.
summary: Scale test deploying 5000 VMs using a two-phase approach (NICs → VMs) to avoid ARM rate limiting.
